integrity: Proof uses exact spectral decomposition and rational positivity comparisons; executable exact-symbolic and direct-matrix checks are included. Finite computations corroborate, not prove, the infinite theorem. No claim of independent verification.
scientific_limitations: For unweighted complete split graphs K_r join independent m only, integer r>=4,m>=3 and exactly three noise-free leaders. Unweighted variance normalization J=trace(L_FF^-1), equal to twice stationary variance for independent unit-intensity diffusion noises. Nonuniform coupling, other budget and finite-gain leaders not covered. Specialized prior coverage may be missed.
title: Exact three-leader coherence phases in complete split networks
